summary: Disputed regularization of gardeners; dual Labour Court awards—one reinstating with back wages, another denying relief based on contractor engagement; High Court modifies to re-engagement on daily wages with minimum pay and future regularization consideration; constitutional ban on recruitment cited; standard of direct supervision and continuous service examined; Sections 6E, 6N U.P. Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 violation alleged; 'equal pay for equal work' invoked; Umadevi precedent relied on; High Court interference assessed for jurisdictional overreach; final relief to balance service continuity and recruitment constraints.
legal_provisions_cited: Secretary, State of Karnataka vs Umadevi (2006) 4 SCC 1
final_judgment: Appeal disposed of with direction to follow due process for re-engagement within constitutional framework; future regularization subject to availability of vacancies and compliance with statutory and constitutional norms; exact quantum of back wages and mode of re-employment to be determined by appropriate authority in accordance with law.
